summary.text: Judith Taylor is the Democratic candidate for the Alabama House of Representatives, District 63, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Norman Crow.

paragraphs.text: Taylor was the Democratic nominee in the January 13, 2026, special general election for the same seat, which Crow won with 64.5 percent of the vote to her 35.5 percent.
For the regular election, Taylor advanced without appearing on a primary ballot, because the Democratic primary scheduled for May 19, 2026, was canceled.
